verdict.rationale: Linear's developer docs are served as Markdown pages (e.g. /developers/graphql.md, /developers/agents.md, /developers/aig.md), which an agent can ingest directly. It also publishes agent-focused guidance on integrating AI agents and agent interaction guidelines. Missing for 10: any explicit llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, documentation stating the .md pages are intended for agent consumption, and independent or hands-on confirmation that agents can usefully consume these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: How to best integrate an AI agent into Linear
The agent must signal its identity clearly so that it can never be mistaken for a person.
Agents behave similar to other users in a workspace.
